summary.text: Karl Bohnak is the Republican state representative for Michigan House District 109, which he has held since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a meteorologist, author and historian.

paragraphs.text: Karl Bohnak took office in the state House on January 1, 2025, succeeding Democrat Jenn Hill, who held District 109 before him.
